name: Latin

dialogue.note: Use “ ” for dialogue; for classical flavor keep dialogus marks minimal.

formality.note: Violet↔Xaden use tu; authorities addressed with vos + titles (domine).

magicSystem: Sigillum (Signet) hierarchy: eques → sigillum → conductus (conduit) → custodes (ward). Runa manet 'runa'; Empyreum pro Empyrean; venenum pro Venin.
blurb: Violet in Aretia expergiscitur, turbata, anulo et epistula Xaden: «Noli me quaerere.» Intellegit se nuptam esse, sed virum suum in tenebris perisse. Custodibus ruentibus, Violet debet inter fidem imperii et veritatem eligere.

styleSheet.numerals: Roman numerals in formal contexts, Western Arabic otherwise
